correctness.rationale: Explicit stationary construction; conditioning on Poisson collision partition yields exactly one-time Gaussian marginals and two-time covariance. Complete four-time Wick-pairing decomposition gives positive connected kernel with the correct total-gap survival probability. Ordered simplex integration yields the exact positive fourth displacement cumulant. The Laplace-weighted lag distributions imply strict two-window ratio monotonicity; fixed-lambda cumulant integrand implies strict r monotonicity. Code independently checked 250 eight-partition moments, 80 inversions, 237 ratio inequalities and separate 150,000-history conditional-Gaussian Monte Carlo, plus asymptotic coefficients. Finite checks are supporting, not proofs.

value.rationale: A common thermostat mechanism produces a process with exactly Gaussian velocity marginals and exactly Gaussian-OU covariance at every lag, making all second-order transport measurement insufficient to detect collisions. The strictly positive displacement fourth cumulant and a minimal three-moment exact inverse recover hidden physical rate parameters from positions alone. This solves a motivated identifiability boundary, provides precise finite-time formula and relevant short/long-time behavior; not an arbitrary parameter slice, renaming or routine numerical recomputation.
